TypeScript Component

Screensaver

An inactivity-based screensaver system with video and audio support. Perfect for kiosk displays, digital signage, and interactive installations.

Interactive Demo

The screensaver activates after a period of inactivity. Move your mouse or press any key to reset the timer.

Features

⏱️ Configurable Timeout

Set custom inactivity periods before screensaver activation.

🎬 Video Support

Display videos during screensaver mode with automatic playback.

🔊 Audio Support

Play audio tracks with volume control during screensaver.

🎯 Activity Detection

Monitors mouse movement, keyboard input, and touch events.

Usage

Basic Usage

import { Screensaver } from 'move.gl'; const screensaver = new Screensaver({ timeout: 300000, // 5 minutes videoUrl: 'path/to/video.mp4', audioUrl: 'path/to/audio.mp3', containerId: 'screensaver', videoId: 'screensaverVideo', audioId: 'screensaverAudio' }); // Control volume screensaver.setVolume(0.5); // Manual control screensaver.activate(); screensaver.deactivate(); // Clean up screensaver.destroy();

HTML Structure

<!-- Screensaver container --> <div id="screensaver" class="screensaver-overlay"> <video id="screensaverVideo" muted loop></video> <audio id="screensaverAudio" loop></audio> </div>

API Reference

ScreensaverOptions Interface

interface ScreensaverOptions { timeout: number; // Inactivity timeout in ms videoUrl?: string; // URL for video source audioUrl?: string; // URL for audio source containerId?: string; // Container element ID videoId?: string; // Video element ID audioId?: string; // Audio element ID }

Methods

Method Description
activate() Manually activate the screensaver
deactivate() Deactivate and hide the screensaver
setVolume(volume: number) Set audio volume (0-1)
destroy() Clean up and remove event listeners
